gre_general.quote: GRE scores will not be considered.

supervisor.value: Applicants should contact faculty first and are rarely admitted without such conversations.
supervisor.quote: The next step in your process should be to contact a faculty member(s) with whom you’d like to study directly | Applicants are rarely admitted without such preliminary conversations.

funding.value: All PhD students in good standing are guaranteed up to five years of stipend support, health insurance and tuition.
funding.quote: This system guarantees all PhD students in good standing up to five years of stipend support and health insurance.

entry_route.value: No master's degree is required before the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Boston University does not require a Master’s degree prior to beginning the PhD.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study
